abilities.name: Salvage Right
abilities.text: Once per round, after you clear a yellow threat or salvage sector, gain 1 Salvage or buy 1 revealed Equipment for 1 less Salvage.

abilities.name: Scrap Bastion
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Forge on tests in sectors with salvage, machine, or hazard tags.

abilities.name: Yard Warden
abilities.text: After you clear a salvage site, record the yard's cleanest sale route in your private notes.

abilities.name: Last Haul
abilities.text: When you would lose Gear, you may discard 1 Salvage instead. Weakness: Salvage Right cannot be used on blue Anomaly sectors.
